title: Zambia Vote Tally Questioned as Opposition Plans Court Challenge
title_cn: 赞比亚计票结果受到质疑，反对派计划提出挑战
summary: A Zambian election watchdog questioned the credibility of the southern African nation’s Aug. 13 vote, after the main opposition leader said he’ll challenge the outcome in court

title: Germany Says Lower 60% Gas Storage Target Sufficient for Winter
title_cn: 德国表示将天然气储存目标降低 60% 足以应对冬季
summary: Gas storage levels between 60% and 70% at the start of winter would be adequate, according to Germany’s Economy Ministry, indicating that Europe’s top energy consumer would have a thin buffer against supply disruptions.

title: Lula, favorito para ganar las elecciones de Brasil
title_cn: 卢拉是赢得巴西大选的热门人选
summary: Un año después de que su popularidad cayera a mínimos históricos, Lula es el favorito para la reelección gracias a la ayuda de dos adversarios de derecha: Donald Trump y Jair Bolsonaro.

title: Bessent to Detail US Plans to Isolate Iran’s Economy on Monday
title_cn: 贝森特周一将详细介绍美国孤立伊朗经济的计划
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the US will soon unveil its plan to economically isolate Iran and its trading partners, after President Donald Trump threatened Tehran and others with “an ECONOMIC D-DAY” to end the current stalemate in the Middle East.

title: Bessent Says Recent Bond Moves Have Just Been 'Noise'
title_cn: 贝森特称最近的债券走势只是“噪音”
summary: “Anything that happens within a 24-hour period is noise,” US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent tells reporters, responding to a question about the bond market erasing gains since the Trump administration’s decision to increase buybacks of longer-dated bonds. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Proposed H-1B Worker Fee Update Clears White House Review Hurdle
title_cn: 提议的 H-1B 工人费用更新清除了白宫审查障碍
summary: A Department of Homeland Security proposal governing petition fees for H-1B workers received approval from the White House, signaling public release soon.
